race.comment: KENNY'S SWANS (1) is a very promising, and lightly tried 4YO gelding who resumed with a bold effort for second by a short-head at Wagga just over a fortnight ago. He slots into the pole position this time, and with the winkers on, he is nicely poised to go one better. THE GLEN (6) made solid progress last season, and will have matured over his spell. He resumes without a trial, but draws close in, and is not to be underestimated. Check the market moves. NAVAJO CODE (5) was perfectly ridden fresh up when getting in the final stride to score by a nose at Moruya, and he should continue to improve with more racing. Stick with him on an each-way basis. FORREST DANCER (3) resumes from a spell, and he is another to be included in all combos. DUNDEEL FLYER (13) resumes from a spell, and is capable of a sharp run, so keep her safe from a good gate.
